mentions.name: bsub.io
mentions.description: This service provides batch processing for developers: users submit heavy-duty jobs without worrying about infrastructure, and bsub handles execution. It starts with PDF extraction, with audio transcoding and speech-to-text next, followed by video transcoding, so a $5/mo VPS is enough to get media operations done.
mentions.problem: Heavy-duty jobs like media processing normally require dedicated infrastructure; bsub lets a $5/mo VPS suffice.
mentions.audience: Developers who need to run heavy-duty batch jobs without managing infrastructure
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://www.bsub.io - batch processing for developers.

You submit heavy duty jobs without worrying about infra, and we take care of execution. We're starting with PDF extraction. Audio transcoding + STT (speech to text) is next. Video transcoding will follow.

This allows you to have $5/mo VPS and get media operations figured out.
